text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp's already over, huh... I 
wonder if I managed to grow properly...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Once summer ends and autumn arrives, it'll 
finally be time for the Kikuka Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
We don't have much time left, but there's 
still some. I have to train hard until the 
big day...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, even after we get back to the 
academy, I look forward to working with 
you!!
